diffs.diff: thermocouple temperature (degC), 19-bit signed linearized TC temperature: datasheet reading gives 0.0078125 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: MAX31856 datasheet: '19-Bit, 0.0078125°C Thermocouple Temperature Resolution'; Electrical Characteristics 'Resolution 0.0078125 °C'; registers 0Ch-0Eh (LTCBH/LTCBM/LTCBL) hold 'the 19-bit register that contains the linearized and cold-junction-compensated thermocouple temperature'. The model already uses exactly this constant: sim.spiReplies match '0c' -> {control:'value', bits:19, scale:0.0078125, signed:true}, the driver returns raw*0.0078125 after >>5 and 19-bit sign extension, and buildNotes state 0.0078125 C/LSB. The gate reports 'none' only because authorConversions() in scripts/parts/publish.ts scans sim.responses/measure(s), not sim.spiReplies (the field the spi-device sim actually uses, src/core/customParts.ts:64 and src/sim/engine.ts:974). check.ts PASSes (TC=250.50C CJ=27.25C).
